notes.title: Patch notes for v1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hi everyone. Got a new patch for you. This won't be the last patch, but it fixes quite a few issues.

-The intro cutscene will no longer play multiple times.
-Smelting iron in the lava furnace now gives 8 iron ingots instead of 5.
-Buffed several of Moltyrs attacks.
-Decreased life regeneration at higher difficulties.
-Increased blackrock harvesting yield.
-Increased the base HP of the blob boss.
-Decreased base hp of the phantom crystal spider hatchlings.
-Decreased the damage dealt by phantom crystal spider hatchlings.

-Fixed a UI issue where the key stencils would overlap text on the superboss key pages.
-Fixed a bug where the 'Speedrunner' achievement was not awarding properly.
-Fixed a bug where the 'Prithee Be Careful' achievement was not awarding properly.
-Fixed a bug where the ice chunk healthbar could go into the negatives.
-Fixed a bug where the ice cubes would not fully disappear upon defeating a boss.
-Fixed an issue where hwachas would cause sound issues.
-Fixed a bug where the esks were facing the wrong direction.
-Fixed several more spelling errors in Krieg's logs.
-Fixed a bug where losing the game at the same time as defeating a boss will cause the game over screen to not work properly.
-Fixed a bug where the esks were facing the wrong direction.
-Fixed several more spelling errors in Krieg's logs.
-Fixed an issue where some canvases would not scale with screen resolution.
-Fixed a bug where phantoms spawned by blackrock were not being affected by the enemy health multiplier.

notes.title: Patch notes for v1.0.1
notes.notes:
-Fixed a bug where Alioe's laser would not damage the player in tower build mode.
-Fixed a bug where the tower build camera could sometimes get stuck.
-Fixed a couple of spelling issues.
-Tweaked one of the story interactions.
